scope: Reviewed operator-provided host export plus independent local review of the copied pure-code candidate; not live host attestation
cause: The model emitted the required literal candidate marker at the end of a sentence. The controller incorrectly required its own line and classified the completed turn as needs-local-repair before validation.

independentLocalCandidateReview.review: Named pure ESM export implements the approved below-range, above-range and unchanged-value behavior. No imports, I/O or external calls.

verification.controllerRegression: An inline terminal marker triggers every configured independent validation command before candidate-ready. The model marker alone cannot establish readiness.

limitations: The original host attempt remains needs-local-repair; no state or evidence was rewritten as successful.
The copied candidate passed independent local validation; the actual host controller never reached its validation phase in this attempt.
A fresh end-to-end host trial using the corrected parser is still required before closing issue #5.
